source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Unarmed large shrub or small tree to ca. 6 m
morphology_documented.buds: Naked winter buds lacking scales, densely brown hairy
morphology_documented.leaves: Oblong-lanceolate, finely or obscurely toothed, pinnately veined, glabrous to soft-hairy beneath, particularly main veins
morphology_documented.flowers: Yellow-green axillary compact umbel-like clusters, calyx 3–4 mm, petals 1–1.3 mm, emerging with or after leaves
morphology_documented.fruit: Drupe 5–8 mm, red before ripening black

source_scope_note: Genus/key traits explicitly identified; modern secondary evidence separately cited; no unsupported species characters inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: History includes Rhamnus combination; naked buds distinguish Frangula
Flora notes potential toxins; no management/consumption advice inferred
